name: Magnetic Picture Frames
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

Each picture frame has two 2 plates, front and back, made from durable, high-quality 3mm acrylic, this magnetic picture frame provides a sleek, modern display solution. Each product includes a custom-sized acrylic stand that perfectly fits the frame dimensions. The photo is printed on premium photo paper and inserted between two clear acrylic layers – or can be left blank for customers who prefer to add their own image later.

  • Magnetic Structure:

The two plates are held together by up to 12 small magnets (6 pairs). The quantity and position of magnets vary depending on the frame size to ensure strong magnetic force, keeping the photo tightly and securely in place without slipping, movement or fall out.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
  • The frame comes in two main custom-shaped sizes:

 - Vertical Strip Style:

 + Dimensions: 8 x 4 in ~ 20.32 cm x 10.16 cm

 + Stand size: 4.32 x 2.36 in ~ 11 x 6 cm

 - Square Frame Style:

 + Dimensions: 8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm

 + Stand size: 5.9 x 2.36 inches ~ 15 x 6 cm

  • The size of custom shape so the product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:

Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and crisp, high-resolution images.

Available in 2 printing options for single-sided or double-sided printing depending on customer preference.

  • Choose between:

- Printed photo: We print your custom photos/pictures.

 - Without photo: You insert your own photos/pictures later.

 

  • Functionality & Stylish Display:

This magnetic picture frame is designed to beautifully display cherished memories. Ideal for desktops, shelves, or mantels, this frame is ideal for showcasing memories with a modern, clean aesthetic. Easy to open and reassemble, perfect for changing pictures as often as you like.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A thoughtful and meaningful gift for all ages, this frame is perfect for: Graduations, Anniversaries, Birthdays, Holidays (Christmas, Mother’s Day, Valentine’s Day, etc.), or any celebration or milestone. Customizable and personal, it’s a heartfelt way to commemorate life’s most precious moments.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Picture Frames

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
